subject: Physics
chapter: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
question_text: A solid cylinder of mass M and radius R rolls without slipping on a horizontal surface and then rolls up an inclined plane of inclination angle \theta. Find the maximum height reached.
solution_latex: Using conservation of mechanical energy for pure rolling: E_initial = \frac{1}{2} M v^2 + \frac{1}{2} I \omega^2. For a solid cylinder, I = \frac{1}{2} M R^2 and v = R \omega. Thus, E_initial = \frac{3}{4} M v^2. At maximum height h, E_final = M g h. Equating both: M g h = \frac{3}{4} M v^2 \implies h = \frac{3 v^2}{4 g}.

subject: Chemistry
question_text: Calculate the work done during the isothermal reversible expansion of 2 moles of an ideal gas from 10 L to 20 L at 300 K.
solution_latex: For isothermal reversible expansion: W = -2.303 n R T \log_{10}(V_2 / V_1). Substituting n = 2, R = 8.314 J/(mol K), T = 300 K, V_2/V_1 = 2: W = -2.303 \times 2 \times 8.314 \times 300 \times \log_{10}(2) \approx -3457.8 \text{ J}.

subject: Mathematics
question_text: Evaluate the integral I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin^3 x}{\sin^3 x + \cos^3 x} dx.
solution_latex: Apply King's property \int_a^b f(x) dx = \int_a^b f(a+b-x) dx: I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\cos^3 x}{\cos^3 x + \sin^3 x} dx. Adding both equations: 2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} 1 dx = \frac{\pi}{2} \implies I = \frac{\pi}{4}.
